name: 눈썹 자연스러움 분석
algorithm: Eyebrow Naturalness — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes eyebrow movement patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **EyebrowLandmark추적**: Precise eyebrow landmarks are tracked per frame, measuring: arch height, arch position, medial endpoint, lateral endpoint, and brow thickness. These geometric parameters capture eyebrow shape and position with sub-pixel accuracy.

2. **BrowMovementDynamics**: Eyebrow movements are analyzed for naturalness — raise speed, lowering speed, asymmetric movement patterns. Natural brow movements follow physiological constraints of the frontalis and corrugator muscles. Deepfake generators may produce brow movements that are too symmetric, too fast/slow, or follow unnatural trajectories.

3. **Brow-ExpressionCoordination**: Eyebrow position is tightly coupled with facial expressions — surprise raises brows, anger lowers them, skepticism raises one brow. The method verifies temporal coordination between brow position and other facial features (eyes, mouth). Deepfakes may show decoupled brow-expression dynamics.

4. **Brow텍스처&머리카락Detail**: Individual eyebrow hairs should be visible in high-resolution video and maintain consistent texture across frames. The method analyzes brow texture quality — AI generators often produce smoothed brow regions lacking individual hair detail or showing temporally inconsistent hair rendering.

5. **BilateralBrow대칭성**: Natural eyebrows show characteristic bilateral asymmetry that remains consistent. The method tracks left-right brow asymmetry — deepfakes may produce brow movements with incorrect asymmetry patterns (too symmetric or varying asymmetry frame-to-frame). The score combines dynamic naturalness, coordination, texture quality, and symmetry analysis.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through eyebrow naturalness analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
